At 7ft (2.1m) tall, the Majestic Pine Christmas Tree is perfect for creating a stunning centerpiece in any home or event space.</p><ul><li>7ft (2.1m) tall - a grand and elegant holiday focal point</li><li>Hinged branches for easy assembly and storage</li><li>Two-tone green PVC needles for a realistic, textured appearance</li><li>Sturdy frame for stability</li></ul>
